description.value: Vancouver Urban Winery is a working urban winery and atmospheric event venue in Railtown, housed in a 1923 building featuring exposed Douglas fir beams and floor-to-ceiling barrels. Established in 2011, it produces its own label wines and pours a rotating selection of over 30 BC wines on tap. Casual visitors are welcome for wine flights and tastings alongside the private-event bookings that anchor the business.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms 55 Dunlevy Ave, Vancouver, BC V6A 3A3 and the business is clearly active as a winery and event venue. However, the OSM phone (+1-604-566-9463) and email (info@vancouverurbanwinery.com) both differ from what the website consistently displays across all pages (604-699-1989 and info@vanurban.co), so the website values are preferred and the discrepancies flagged. No bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, or cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website; the venue does explicitly list 'Accessible Bathroom(s)' as a feature of both event spaces.

Venue is primarily an event-booking operation; drop-in hospitality for cyclists is possible but not foregrounded.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The venue welcomes casual drop-in wine tastings, but it is primarily a private-event booking operation; a touring cyclist could stop in, but cycle-friendly amenities (bike parking, water refill, takeout) are entirely unconfirmed. Worth a follow-up call to determine whether walk-in service is reliably available.
